description: Classifies CGA-Bench failing episodes by ASC structural visibility: Class-A (omission, ASC-visible) vs Class-B (commission/timing/sequence, ASC-invisible). Proves structural blind spots are not threshold artefacts.

class_a.name: ASC-visible
class_a.rationale: Omission = missing action reduces action coverage, so ASC can in principle detect this failure.

class_b.name: ASC-invisible
class_b.rationale: Commission/timing/sequence = agent performed an action (coverage stays high) or acted at wrong time/order. Coverage metric cannot distinguish these from correct behaviour.
